title: Volcanoes of Philippines (hot and cold)
intro: 10 volcanoes of Philippines, one after another. You have three tries for each place and are told warmer or colder after a miss. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders, and you work inside this area.

rounds.name: Mount Talinis
rounds.fact: Mount Talinis is a volcano with a recorded summit elevation of 1,862 m in the source data. The data places it in Philippines.
